name: MonarchPricingTable
title: PricingTable
summary: Plans compared feature by feature with a billing period picker: one plan per page with its features below on a phone, plans as columns and features as rows from 640dp wide. Prices are shown exactly as given.
whenToUse: On an upgrade or plans screen that compares two to five plans across the same features.
whenNotToUse: For one plan, or plans without a shared feature list, use MonarchPlanCard. An app that sells digital goods in an app store must follow that store's billing rules; this component only shows plans.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPricingTable(plans: List<MonarchPricingPlan>, features: List<MonarchPricingFeature>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, periods: List<MonarchPricingPeriod> = emptyList(), period: String? = null, onPeriodChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, layout: MonarchPricingTableLayout = MonarchPricingTableLayout.Automatic, showPrices: Boolean = true, showPeriodPicker: Boolean = true, includedIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchPricingTableLabels = MonarchPricingTableLabels(), action: (@Composable (plan: MonarchPricingPlan) -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchPricingPlan(id: String, name: String, description: String? = null, prices: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), price: String? = null, priceSuffix: String? = null, badge: String? = null, highlighted: Boolean = false, current: Boolean = false)
class MonarchPricingFeature(id: String, label: String, description: String? = null, group: String? = null, values: Map<String, MonarchPricingFeatureValue> = emptyMap())
sealed interface MonarchPricingFeatureValue { data object Included; data object NotIncluded; data class Text(val text: String) }
class MonarchPricingPeriod(id: String, label: String, suffix: String? = null, priceSuffix: String? = null, priceNote: String? = null)
enum class MonarchPricingTableLayout { Automatic, Paged, Grid }
class MonarchPricingTableLabels(caption: String? = null, included: String? = null, notIncluded: String? = null, currentPlan: String? = null, billingPeriod: String? = null, plan: String? = null)

options.name: plans
options.description: The plans in display order: id, name, description, prices per period, fallback price, price suffix, badge, highlighted and current flags.

options.name: features
options.description: The features: id, label, description, group and a value per plan id (Included, NotIncluded or Text). A plan missing from values does not have the feature.

options.name: periods
options.description: Billing periods; with two or more the period picker is shown.

options.name: period
options.description: The chosen period id. null lets the table keep its own choice, starting with the first period.

options.name: onPeriodChange
options.description: Called with the id of the period the user chooses.

options.name: layout
options.description: Automatic (the grid from 640dp wide below font scale 1.3, pages otherwise), Paged or Grid.

options.name: showPeriodPicker
options.description: Whether the period picker is shown; false when the screen shows its own.

options.name: includedIcon
options.description: A mark for an included feature, such as a check. Without it the word "Included" is shown. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Plan comparison", "Included", "Not included", "Current plan", "Billing period" and "Plan".

options.name: action
options.description: The call to action of each plan, normally one MonarchButton.

states.name: paged
states.description: A plan picker (segmented buttons), then one page per plan: a MonarchPlanCard with price, badges and action, and the plan's features grouped below with the included mark or word, a dash or the text.

states.name: grid
states.description: A header per plan with badges, name, price, description and action, then group headings and one row per feature with a cell per plan.

states.name: highlighted plan
states.description: A solid badge and the highlighted MonarchPlanCard on a page; a 2dp accent border around the grid header.

states.name: fallback price
states.description: A plan without a price for the period shows its price, such as "Contact us", without the period's suffix and note.

appearance: Plan pages use MonarchPlanCard. Grid headers have the default border, or a 2dp accent border when highlighted, with the plan name in the subheading style, the price in the heading style and the suffix, note and description in the muted caption color. Feature labels use the body style, descriptions the muted caption color, a dash the subtle text color, and rows are separated by subtle-border lines. The pickers are Material 3 segmented buttons in the MonarchTheme colors. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web PricingTable is one table that scrolls sideways on narrow screens with the feature column pinned, and exports BillingPeriodToggle and helpers. On Android, as on iOS, a phone shows one plan per page (a HorizontalPager) with a plan picker, so the comparison stays readable at large font sizes, and the grid is used from 640dp wide (the width the table is given, not the window) below font scale 1.3. The period picker is a Material 3 single-choice segmented button row; the period's suffix is a line under it rather than inside the segment, as on iOS. The web's caption and hideCaption are the table's spoken name only. Names and parameters follow iOS: MonarchPricingPlan, MonarchPricingFeature, MonarchPricingFeatureValue, MonarchPricingPeriod, MonarchPricingTableLayout, MonarchPricingTableLabels; iOS's isPriceShown and isPeriodPickerShown are showPrices and showPeriodPicker, and the binding is period with onPeriodChange. Feature cells take Included, NotIncluded or Text rather than any node. The included check is a slot because Monarch bundles no icons; without it the word "Included" is shown.
accessibility: The table is a traversal group named "Plan comparison" (or labels.caption); the pickers are named "Billing period" and "Plan".
Picker segments have the RadioButton role, show a check mark when chosen and have touch targets of at least 48dp; they follow the layout direction.
On a page each feature is one element read as its name, its value and its description, such as "Single sign-on, Included, SAML and OIDC".
In the grid each cell is one element read as the plan, the feature and the value, such as "Team, Single sign-on: Included".
Group titles are headings, and plan names are headings through MonarchPlanCard on pages.
Checks and dashes are not read; the words carry the value, so nothing depends on color or shape alone.
Feature text wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: More than five plans make grid columns narrow; use pages or fewer plans.
Pages can differ in height; content under the pager moves when a taller page is shown.
Segmented pickers share the width, so long period or plan names wrap; keep them short.
A period id that is not in periods falls back to the first period.
Swiping between pages with TalkBack was not tried on a device; the plan picker is the way to change page without swiping.

examples.title: Plans with a billing-period toggle
examples.template:
MonarchPricingTable(
    plans = listOf(
        MonarchPricingPlan(
            id = {{plans.0.id}},
            name = {{plans.0.name}},
            description = {{plans.0.description}},
            prices = mapOf({{periods.0.value}} to {{plans.0.prices.monthly}}, {{periods.1.value}} to {{plans.0.prices.yearly}}),
        ),
        MonarchPricingPlan(
            id = {{plans.1.id}},
            name = {{plans.1.name}},
            description = {{plans.1.description}},
            prices = mapOf({{periods.0.value}} to {{plans.1.prices.monthly}}, {{periods.1.value}} to {{plans.1.prices.yearly}}),
            badge = {{plans.1.badge}},
            highlighted = {{plans.1.highlighted}},
        ),
        MonarchPricingPlan(
            id = {{plans.2.id}},
            name = {{plans.2.name}},
            description = {{plans.2.description}},
            price = {{plans.2.price}},
        )
    ),
    features = listOf(
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = {{features.0.id}},
            label = {{features.0.label}},
            values = mapOf({{plans.0.id}} to value({{features.0.values.starter}}), {{plans.1.id}} to value({{features.0.values.team}}), {{plans.2.id}} to value({{features.0.values.enterprise}})),
        ),
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = {{features.1.id}},
            label = {{features.1.label}},
            values = mapOf({{plans.0.id}} to value({{features.1.values.starter}}), {{plans.1.id}} to value({{features.1.values.team}}), {{plans.2.id}} to value({{features.1.values.enterprise}})),
        ),
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = {{features.2.id}},
            label = {{features.2.label}},
            description = {{features.2.description}},
            group = {{features.2.group}},
            values = mapOf({{plans.0.id}} to value({{features.2.values.starter}}), {{plans.1.id}} to value({{features.2.values.team}}), {{plans.2.id}} to value({{features.2.values.enterprise}})),
        ),
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = {{features.3.id}},
            label = {{features.3.label}},
            group = {{features.3.group}},
            values = mapOf({{plans.2.id}} to value({{features.3.values.enterprise}})),
        )
    ),
    periods = listOf(
        MonarchPricingPeriod(id = {{periods.0.value}}, label = {{periods.0.label}}, priceSuffix = {{periods.0.priceSuffix}}),
        MonarchPricingPeriod(id = {{periods.1.value}}, label = {{periods.1.label}}, priceSuffix = {{periods.1.priceSuffix}}, priceNote = {{periods.1.priceNote}}),
    ),
    period = period,
    onPeriodChange = { period = it },
    labels = MonarchPricingTableLabels(caption = {{caption}}),
) { plan ->
    when (plan.id) {
        {{plans.0.id}} -> MonarchButton(
            text = {{plans.0.action.label}},
            onClick = { chosen = plan.id },
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{plans.0.action.variant|pascal}},
            size = MonarchButtonSize.{{plans.0.action.size|pascal}},
        )
        {{plans.1.id}} -> MonarchButton(
            text = {{plans.1.action.label}},
            onClick = { chosen = plan.id },
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{plans.1.action.variant|pascal}},
            size = MonarchButtonSize.{{plans.1.action.size|pascal}},
        )
        {{plans.2.id}} -> MonarchButton(
            text = {{plans.2.action.label}},
            onClick = { chosen = plan.id },
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{plans.2.action.variant|pascal}},
            size = MonarchButtonSize.{{plans.2.action.size|pascal}},
        )
        else -> {}
    }
}
examples.code:
MonarchPricingTable(
    plans = listOf(
        MonarchPricingPlan(
            id = "starter",
            name = "Starter",
            description = "For individuals.",
            prices = mapOf("monthly" to "₹A", "yearly" to "₹B"),
        ),
        MonarchPricingPlan(
            id = "team",
            name = "Team",
            description = "For small teams.",
            prices = mapOf("monthly" to "₹C", "yearly" to "₹D"),
            badge = "Recommended",
            highlighted = true,
        ),
        MonarchPricingPlan(
            id = "enterprise",
            name = "Enterprise",
            description = "For larger organisations.",
            price = "Contact us",
        )
    ),
    features = listOf(
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = "projects",
            label = "Projects",
            values = mapOf("starter" to value("Up to 3"), "team" to value(true), "enterprise" to value(true)),
        ),
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = "members",
            label = "Members",
            values = mapOf("starter" to value("1"), "team" to value("Up to 25"), "enterprise" to value(true)),
        ),
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = "sso",
            label = "Single sign-on",
            description = "SAML and OIDC",
            group = "Security",
            values = mapOf("starter" to value(false), "team" to value(true), "enterprise" to value(true)),
        ),
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            id = "audit",
            label = "Audit log",
            group = "Security",
            values = mapOf("enterprise" to value(true)),
        )
    ),
    periods = listOf(
        MonarchPricingPeriod(id = "monthly", label = "Monthly", priceSuffix = "/ month"),
        MonarchPricingPeriod(id = "yearly", label = "Yearly", priceSuffix = "/ year", priceNote = "Billed yearly"),
    ),
    period = period,
    onPeriodChange = { period = it },
    labels = MonarchPricingTableLabels(caption = "Compare plans"),
) { plan ->
    when (plan.id) {
        "starter" -> MonarchButton(
            text = "Choose Starter",
            onClick = { chosen = plan.id },
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary,
            size = MonarchButtonSize.Md,
        )
        "team" -> MonarchButton(
            text = "Choose Team",
            onClick = { chosen = plan.id },
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
            size = MonarchButtonSize.Md,
        )
        "enterprise" -> MonarchButton(
            text = "Talk to sales",
            onClick = { chosen = plan.id },
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary,
            size = MonarchButtonSize.Md,
        )
        else -> {}
    }
}

examples.title: A grid without prices
examples.code:
MonarchPricingTable(
    plans = listOf(MonarchPricingPlan("free", "Free"), MonarchPricingPlan("pro", "Pro", current = true)),
    features = listOf(
        MonarchPricingFeature(
            "history",
            "Version history",
            values = mapOf(
                "free" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Text("7 days"),
                "pro" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Text("1 year"),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    layout = MonarchPricingTableLayout.Grid,
    showPrices = false,
)
